transport: solution/main.py reads persistent UTF-8 JSON lines and writes exactly one finite JSON object per request. Protocol responses occupy stdout; diagnostics may use stderr.
execution: Final prediction uses one process in a private chroot as UID/GID 65534. Runtime and solution are read-only; scratch is writable. The trusted scorer, SDK and reference labels stay outside the child filesystem. Network, new processes and namespace access are denied.
software: Offline CPU Python 3.11 with the default numerical libraries. Bundle pure-Python dependencies and model assets inside solution/. The runtime permits threads; forked workers and external executables are unavailable.
final_inputs: The prediction request sends all final target-free records. Reference labels remain under verifier/test/data/.
scoring: Every test record counted once in absolute error mean; auxiliary per-ligand groups count a record once in each ligand group it contains. Missing, duplicate or extra IDs and nonfinite/boolean values are invalid.
